data.narrative:
Netrasemi is a Series A-stage semiconductor company founded by Jyothis Indirabhai, Deepa Geetha, and Sreejith Varma, having raised ₹107 Cr (~$13M) to date. The valuation analysis draws from a comp universe of 8 private and 3 public semiconductor firms, including same-stage peers SambaNova Systems, Rebellions, and d-Matrix.

Two valuation methods prove applicable. Stage-progression analysis, using total raised ($13M) as a proxy base value and applying a standard 2.0x Series A step-up multiplier, implies a valuation of $26M. Peer-median triangulation across three same-sector, same-stage comparables yields $2.3B, though the peer set exhibits substantial dispersion ($2.0B to $11.0B). Public-comp anchoring using semiconductor sector multiples (18.4x P/S across ALAB, NVDA, AMD) cannot be applied absent disclosed revenue figures.

The two applicable methods produce a wide range reflecting stage and market-signal divergence. The triangulated analysis supports a low-to-high band of $22M to $2.7B, with a median of $1.2B. Stage-progression anchors conservatively near total raised; peer-median suggests substantially higher valuations consistent with venture-backed semiconductor infrastructure plays. Key uncertainties include the company's revenue trajectory, competitive positioning within the peer cohort, and whether capital raised reflects market risk pricing or platform defensibility. Resolution of these factors will materially narrow the valuation range at next funding event.
